scenes.hook: These navigation links need to work on a phone as well as a desktop.
scenes.idea: Put real links inside a navigation element. Each link needs a destination.
scenes.code: Set display to flex to arrange the links. Gap adds space between them.
scenes.result: Now add flex wrap. When the container gets narrower, links move onto another line.
scenes.tip: The links stay visible instead of being squeezed into unreadable text.
scenes.caution: This is a wrapping menu. A separate collapsible menu would need an accessible toggle and keyboard support.
scenes.try: Try three links, then shrink the available width. Can you still use every link?
scenes.close: Subscribe to Tech at sixty for practical web projects.
